Use `snl entry references` to enumerate structured references to one Entry before rename, deletion, or dependency analysis.

### Agent procedure
1. Supply the exact Entry ID and inspect every returned reference class.
2. Use the result as a safety gate; do not infer absence from text search or a truncated human display.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl entry references` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
